name: Get Alert Types
description: Get Alert Types Gets a list of all alert types for which an account is eligible. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/available_alerts
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/available_alerts
Gets a list of all alert types for which an account is eligible.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Create PagerDuty integration token
description: Create PagerDuty integration token Creates a new token for integrating with PagerDuty. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty/connect
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty/connect
Creates a new token for integrating with PagerDuty.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Connect PagerDuty
description: Connect PagerDuty Links PagerDuty with the account using the integration token. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty/connect/{token_id}

name: Delete PagerDuty Services
description: Delete PagerDuty Services Deletes all the PagerDuty Services connected to the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty
Deletes all the PagerDuty Services connected to the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: List PagerDuty services
description: List PagerDuty services Get a list of all configured PagerDuty services. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/pagerduty
Get a list of all configured PagerDuty services.
Required: account_id (path)

name: List History
description: List History Gets a list of history records for notifications sent to an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/history
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/history
Gets a list of history records for notifications sent to an account. The records are displayed for last `x` number of days based on the zone plan (free = 30, pro = 30, biz = 30, ent = 90).
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: per_page (query); before (query); page (query); since (query)

name: Get delivery mechanism eligibility
description: Get delivery mechanism eligibility Get a list of all delivery mechanism types for which an account is eligible. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/eligible
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/eligible
Get a list of all delivery mechanism types for which an account is eligible.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Create a Notification policy
description: Create a Notification policy Creates a new Notification policy. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies
Creates a new Notification policy.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a Notification policy
description: Delete a Notification policy Delete a Notification policy. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}

name: Get a Notification policy
description: Get a Notification policy Get details for a single policy. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}

name: List Notification policies
description: List Notification policies Get a list of all Notification policies. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies
Get a list of all Notification policies.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Show email unsubscribe details
description: Show email unsubscribe details Shows details for unsubscribing an email address from a notification policy. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}/email/unsubscribe
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}/email/unsubscribe
Shows details for unsubscribing an email address from a notification policy.
Required: account_id (path); policy_id (path); email (query); token (query)

name: Test a Notification policy
description: Test a Notification policy Send a test notification for a policy to verify delivery mechanisms are working as expected. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}/test
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}/test
Send a test notification for a policy to verify delivery mechanisms are working as expected.
Required: account_id (path); policy_id (path)
Optional: body (body) — Optional configuration for the test notification. When omitted, a default INFO-severity test alert is sent.

name: Unsubscribe email from a Notification policy
description: Unsubscribe email from a Notification policy Unsubscribes an email address from a notification policy. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}/email/unsubscribe
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}/email/unsubscribe
Unsubscribes an email address from a notification policy.
Required: account_id (path); policy_id (path); email (query); token (query)

name: Update a Notification policy
description: Update a Notification policy Update a Notification policy. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/policies/{policy_id}

name: Create Silences
description: Create Silences Creates a new silence for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences
Creates a new silence for an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Silence
description: Delete Silence Deletes an existing silence for an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences/{silence_id}

name: Get Silence
description: Get Silence Gets a specific silence for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences/{silence_id}

name: List Silences
description: List Silences Gets a list of silences for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences
Gets a list of silences for an account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update Silences
description: Update Silences Updates existing silences for an account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/silences
Updates existing silences for an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Create a webhook
description: Create a webhook Creates a new webhook destination. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks
Creates a new webhook destination.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a webhook
description: Delete a webhook Delete a configured webhook destination. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks/{webhook_id}

name: Get a webhook
description: Get a webhook Get details for a single webhooks destination. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks/{webhook_id}

name: List webhooks
description: List webhooks Gets a list of all configured webhook destinations. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks
Gets a list of all configured webhook destinations.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update a webhook
description: Update a webhook Update a webhook destination. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/alerting/v3/destinations/webhooks/{webhook_id}
